settings.title: PURPOSE
settings.subtitle: Care That Takes Its Time
settings.content: To help people feel confident in their hair and skin with gentle, doctor-formulated care that respects the scalp and skin as living ecosystems.

settings.title: MISSION
settings.subtitle: Honest, Gentle Formulas
settings.content: To create focused, everyday essentials — cleanse, nourish, hydrate — with thoughtful ingredients, clear labels and no exaggerated promises.

settings.title: VISION
settings.subtitle: Everyday Care, Made in India
settings.content: To build Luma & Pause into a trusted Indian personal care brand whose products earn a permanent place in your daily routine.

settings.heading: Feed it. Restore it. Strengthen it.
settings.lead_text: At Luma & Pause, we believe your skin and scalp are living ecosystems. They don't need rushing — they need time and the right care.
settings.principle_quote: Every ingredient should have a role, every formula should be gentle, and every product should earn its place in your day.

settings.heading: Gentle care. One shared standard.
settings.text:
Luma & Pause was created with a simple belief: everyday hair and skin care should be gentle, honest and doctor-formulated — not harsh, confusing or over-promised.

Healthy hair starts with a healthy scalp, and comfortable skin starts with a supported barrier. So we built our range around three simple steps: Cleanse with a sulfate-free shampoo, Nourish with a lightweight serum and scalp mist, and Hydrate with a refreshing face mist and daily moisturiser.

Every formula is lightweight, non-sticky and made for regular use across hair and skin types.

Probiotic care. Doctor formulated.

settings.heading: What goes into every bottle.
settings.text:
We use familiar, well-understood ingredients such as Panthenol, Glycerin, Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Extract and Menthol to hydrate, soothe and refresh — in textures that absorb quickly and never feel heavy.

Every ingredient is listed in full (INCI) on the pack, so you always know exactly what you are using.

settings.title: Listen first
settings.description: We start by listening to what people actually struggle with — hair fall, dry scalp, dull or dehydrated skin.

settings.title: Define the challenge
settings.description: Insights are shaped into a clear brief: what each product must do, and what it must never do.

settings.title: Engineer with intent
settings.description: Our doctors choose gentle, proven ingredients, each with a clear role in the formula.

settings.title: Test for performance
settings.description: Each formula is checked for stability, skin comfort and safety before it reaches you.

settings.title: Validate at scale
settings.description: Textures and fragrance are refined until they feel right in a real daily routine.

settings.title: Deliver with precision
settings.description: Every batch is made by Dr Expert Formulation Pvt Ltd., Noida, with the same quality checks every time.

settings.heading: Insight-led. Intentionally built.
settings.text: Every formula follows the same disciplined path from question to shelf.

settings.heading: Precision at every step.
settings.text:
Our products are manufactured by Dr Expert Formulation Pvt Ltd., G-56 Gautam Buddha Nagar, Noida Sector 6, UP, and marketed by Luma and Pause Personal Care Pvt. Ltd., Patna, Bihar.

From sourcing and formulation to filling and recyclable packaging, every stage follows strict checks for safety, stability and consistency — so you get the same quality every time. Made in India.

settings.heading: The people behind Luma & Pause.
settings.text: A small team spanning formulation, design and customer care — all working toward the same standard.

settings.title: It Started With a Question
settings.description: Why is so much hair and skin care harsh, heavy or over-promised — when what people really need is gentle care that works over time?

settings.title: We Chose to Build Differently
settings.description: Luma & Pause was created around a simple idea: doctor-formulated care, honest labels and calm, beautiful design.

settings.title: We Looked at the Whole Picture
settings.description: Hair fall, dry scalp, build-up, dehydrated skin. We saw that scalp and skin health sit at the root of them all.

settings.title: The Ritual Took Shape
settings.description: From that came our everyday ritual: CLEANSE · NOURISH · HYDRATE — simple steps for hair, scalp and skin.

settings.title: Every Detail Was Refined
settings.description: Ingredients, textures, packaging and claims were reviewed with one standard: every product should earn its place in your day.

settings.title: This Is Only the Beginning
settings.description: Our first six essentials are just the start of gentle, doctor-formulated care for every routine.
